name: Rosie Rose Florist
what_they_do: Florist and event-decor studio selling bouquets and arrangements online (sympathy, weddings, sweet 16, seasonal) through a Wix store, with in-store pickup and local delivery, plus event decoration work. Runs an 'appointments & questions' enquiry form on the site.
customers: Local gift buyers and families ordering sympathy and celebration flowers, plus brides/event clients needing decor in North Brunswick and nearby towns

size_signals.signal: 'Over 25 years of experience' stated in site copy and meta description
Seasonal catalogue with priced arrangements from about $65 to $265 and out-of-stock items, indicating real inventory management
5.0 rating across 124 reviews (aggregated listing) - strong repeat/referral volume for a single shop
Hours Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-6, Sun 10-3 (not published on their own site)

listing.reviews: 124 (count from Birdeye aggregation of Google reviews; not shown in limited Maps view)

website_review.primary_cta: 'SHOP' in the nav (to /shop) - no call, quote or book button above the fold
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Wix store with priced items, cart and Log In; enquiry form for 'Appointments & Questions'; no calendar booking
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Home page layout renders badly at desktop width (1528px document for a 1440px viewport, horizontal scrollbar, a large empty black band and an oversized blurry hero image); 'Order Online!' is an image of text; the logo is not visible in the header on load
website_review.search_basics: Title wrongly leads with the query 'Florist Near Me' plus 'North Brunswick Township'; no hours on the site; the bundled LocalBusiness schema is type 'Restaurant', which is the wrong business type for a florist
top_issues: Mobile is effectively broken: at a 390px device the layout stays ~1305px wide and scales down, so the nav is cut off and the shop name and phone are unreadable or off-screen
No phone or address next to the logo; no click-to-call anywhere (zero tel: links); no hours anywhere on the site
LocalBusiness schema says 'Restaurant' instead of FloristStore, and no opening hours or service area are published

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile is strong (5.0, Florist category, hours, website, phone, photos) - the shop's best asset. Answerable: website publishes no hours, no delivery area or fee, no delivery cut-off, and the schema mislabels the business as a Restaurant, so an assistant quoting the site would get basics wrong. Bookable: real cart and priced seasonal products for purchase, plus an enquiry form, but the form is 'appointments & questions' with no scheduling and no click-to-call for time-sensitive orders.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile site and put the shop name, phone (click-to-call) and an Order button above the fold - most same-day flower orders start on a phone
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px render scales a 1305px layout into the corner with the nav cut off; zero tel: links and no visible phone in the header at any width

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish hours, delivery towns, delivery cut-off and fees as page text and correct the schema from Restaurant to FloristStore with LocalBusiness hours/areaServed
top_opportunities.evidence: Hours exist only on a third-party aggregator; the site's JSON-LD declares @type 'Restaurant'; find-us page has address, phone and Gmail only

top_opportunities.opportunity: Sympathy and event-order intake agent: capture occasion, delivery date/time, budget and card message, then hand a ready order to staff instead of a free-text form
top_opportunities.evidence: Only intake is a generic 'appointments & questions' Send form plus a phone number; sympathy and wedding are major menu categories

scores.reasons: Strong demand signal (5.0 from 124 reviews) but a badly broken mobile layout and missing basics; a single-shop florist has modest, seasonal budget, and Wix rebuilds take more care than a one-afternoon fix.
